sloka: तमप्रतिमतेजोभ्यां भ्रातृभ्यां रोमहर्षणम् ।विस्मिता: सङ्गमं प्रेक्ष्य समवेता महर्षय: ॥ २.११२.१॥
transliteration: tamapratimatejobhyāṁ bhrātṛbhyāṁ romaharṣaṇam ।vismitā: saṅgamaṁ prekṣya samavetā maharṣaya: ॥ 2.112.1॥

translations.english: The great sages assembled there were amazed at witnessing the meeting of the two brothers (Rama and Bharata) of umparalleled briliance.
